newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA- EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 11.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA- EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 11.

text.p: These are the main headlines reported on Radio Latvia news in the early afternoon on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Parliament's defence committee and national security council agreed on the need to prepare a law on national security.
- Both of the privatisation agency board managers whom Economy Minister Guntar Krasts wants to step down said they will participate in the planned competitions for these posts.
- Rating agency Thomson Bankwatch plans to review its credit ratings of Latvia and Estonia.

- Latvia and Lithuania have started to co-ordinate the text of a sea border agreement, taking the Lithuanian version as the base. The Lithuanian side said this was a success in the three-year long talks. The next round of talks is planned for May in Riga.
